why: Measure the actual published building limit with twelve distinct current custom looks before accepting the maximum-map performance gate.
fixture: 64x64 Mata Atlantica, seed 42, 256 mixed inland buildings, twelve distinct residents with six v5 and six v6 recipes. Not all equipment, crops, routes or every entity limit simultaneously.
finding: 1x simulation keeps pace; 16x rendering and pause latency remain unacceptable for release. This evidence does not pass the performance gate.
diagnostics: Fixed day/night Canvas profiling identifies full-world screen compositing as the largest night draw cost. Software light backing and opaque-world probes have not shown a material improvement; no runtime change promoted.
limits: Each phase is a separate sixty-second window restored from the same opening.
Profiling adds overhead and is diagnostic only.
